regions.region: page 1 lower-right, Scheme 1 and adjacent Introduction text
regions.finding: Prior-literature carbazole synthesis overview; classified as a general scheme, not a reported experiment of this paper.

regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and ESI footnote
regions.finding: Article metadata and high-level reaction claim only; the footnote mentions ESI, but no SI file was supplied or associated.

unresolved: Generic structures in Scheme 1 do not define unique experimental records; SI association remains unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left, Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1-21, and isolated-yield footnote
regions.finding: Twenty-one distinct PtCl2-catalyzed cyclization scope experiments, retained one row per experiment with row-specific time and isolated yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right, Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1-12, and isolated-yield footnote
regions.finding: Twelve distinct 4-monosubstituted allenol cyclization scope experiments, retained one row per experiment.
Narrative interpretation of Tables 1-2 and mechanistic-study lead-in; no extra scope experiment beyond the 33 table rows.

unresolved: Table rows omit reaction scale, exact temperature, atmosphere, solvent volume, workup, purification, and fully resolved structures.

regions.finding: Preparation sequence for labeled precursor 3f-D: oxidation, LiAlD4 reduction, THP protection, and a two-stage allenol synthesis; arrows were reconciled with the detailed experimental text.

regions.region: page 3 center-left, 3f-D to 4f-D arrow and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: Distinct deuterium-labeling cyclization experiment: PtCl2 (5 mol%), toluene, room temperature, 2 h, 86% yield, 94% D in product.
Proposed platinum-carbene mechanism with M2/M3; classified separately and not treated as independent observed reactions.

regions.region: page 3 right column, Experimental Section 1 and start of Section 2
regions.finding: Detailed oxidation to 1-nonyn-3-one and LiAlD4 reduction to 3-deutero-1-nonyn-3-ol; the 1e procedure begins at the page bottom and continues on page 4.

unresolved: Several Scheme 2 arrows omit scale or operational details; proposed intermediates are not experimentally isolated.

regions.region: page 4 left column upper, completion of typical 1e procedure
regions.finding: Detailed indium-mediated preparation of allenol 1e, merged with its page-3 opening text.

regions.region: page 4 remaining two columns, preparations 1f, 1j, 1k, 1l, and start of 1m
regions.finding: Five complete allenol preparations plus the beginning of the cross-page 1m preparation; each product is a distinct experiment under the stated typical procedure.

unresolved: Candidate SMILES for complex allenols were not considered verified; atmosphere is not stated for the indium procedure.

regions.finding: Cross-page 1m experiment completed with 12 h reaction time, 1.1462 g product, and 81% yield.

regions.region: page 5 left column center/lower, preparations 1u and 1q
page 5 right column, Section 4 typical procedure and two arrows for 8c to 9c to 3c
regions.finding: Two-stage preparation of 3c with an unpurified intermediate and a 40% combined isolated yield; stages retained within one experiment record.

unresolved: Intermediate 9c has no separate yield; 3i later cross-references this typical procedure without restating entry-specific durations.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left, preparation 3f-D and its two-arrow scheme
regions.finding: Two-stage preparation of labeled allenol 3f-D, merged with Scheme 2 on page 3; 50% combined yield and 98% D.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left and upper-right, preparation 3h and its two-arrow scheme
regions.finding: Two-stage preparation of 3h with 34% combined yield and entry-specific timing shown in the scheme.
Two-stage preparation of 3i with 31% combined yield; precise entry-specific durations are not restated and remain missing.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right, preparation 3j and two-arrow scheme
regions.finding: Two-stage preparation of 3j with 31% combined yield; characterization continues beyond the current page range but is not needed to identify the experiment.

unresolved: 3i entry-specific time/temperature are not locally restated; complex structures remain machine-unverified; page-7 characterization was not claimed as covered.
